name: vscode-markdown-translator
description: Translate Markdown to the selected target language (default: Simplified Chinese) using OpenRouter models, with incremental translation based on Markdown AST blocks.

commands.title: Markdown Translator: Set OpenRouter API Key
Markdown Translator: Reset OpenRouter API Key
Markdown Translator: Set OpenRouter Model ID
Markdown Translator: Delete all translated files

markdownTranslator.translation.maxBlocks.description: Fallback max number of blocks per API request when the model context window cannot be read.

markdownTranslator.translation.maxContex.description: Max share of the model context window used for each translation request prompt when context length is available.

markdownTranslator.translation.targetLan.description: Target language for translation (shown in onboarding on first use).
自定义目标语言（当 targetLanguage 选择“自定义...”时生效）。

markdownTranslator.translation.systemPro.description: Base system prompt template. Leave empty to use the extension default. Use {targetLanguage} as the target language placeholder.

markdownTranslator.translation.customPro.description: Optional custom prompt appended after the system prompt, such as terminology or style rules.

markdownTranslator.translation.deletionF.description: Fallback to full translation if block deletion is detected.

markdownTranslator.translation.similarit.description: Similarity threshold to treat delete+insert as modification.

enumDescriptions: Write the visible *_mdt.md file next to the source Markdown file.
Write translated Markdown files under the extension private storage directory.
markdownTranslator.storage.outputLocatio.description: Where translated Markdown output files are written. Private storage keeps generated files out of the workspace, but relative Markdown links are resolved from that private directory.

scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run bundle
